name: KL Dance
description: Hustle and ballroom classes by world hustle champions Kelvin and Lori Ann Roche, with Thursday Latin Hustle classes in Bay Shore.
reviewNotes:
No working website or social page found (kldance.net does not resolve). Phone is from The Dance Calendar directory and the Eastern Suffolk BOCES listing. Town = class location; contact address is Brentwood.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Still no website: kldance.net (listed by BOCES) has no DNS record, so no logo or photos are available from an own site. No business Facebook/Instagram page for KL Dance found; only the couple's personal accounts (e.g. Instagram @loriannroche, Facebook kelvin.roche.71, mentioned on danceislife.love), which were not recorded. BOCES also lists the email kelvinandloriann@hotmail.com and a Brentwood address; not recorded because they are not on the couple's own site or business page (owner may decide to add the email). Town Bay Shore = Thursday Latin Hustle class location from the existing record; we could not confirm the Bay Shore class schedule online.

evidence.note: The Dance Calendar studio directory: 'KL Dance - Lori Ann & Kelvin Roche', teaching ballroom styles including hustle, jive, cha cha, rumba and mambo; 631-332-8883.
Eastern Suffolk BOCES Arts in Education listing for Lori Ann Greenhouse / Kelvin Roche: same phone 631-332-8883, website kldance.net, Brentwood NY contact address.
NJ Hustle Congress staff page: Kelvin & Loriann Roche, instructors/judges and 9-time World Hustle Champions, confirming the 'world hustle champions' in our description.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: thedancecalendar.com, artsined.esboces.org, njhustlecongress.com.
